title: DSL-13 regression: ON CONFLICT ON CONSTRAINT fails — unique index not upgraded to named constraint
root_cause: Migration 028 was retroactively modified in DSL-13 to create a named constraint (uq_definition_tenant_version) instead of a unique index. Databases that had migration 028 applied before DSL-13 still carry only a unique index. store.zig was simultaneously updated to use ON CONFLICT ON CONSTRAINT uq_definition_tenant_version, which requires a named constraint — not an index. The INSERT failed with a PostgreSQL error (constraint does not exist), caught as DefinitionError.TransactionFailed.
resolution: Added migration 044_fix_definition_conflict_constraint.sql that idempotently drops the unique index form and creates the named constraint. ON CONFLICT ON CONSTRAINT now resolves correctly.
prevention: When retroactively modifying an already-applied migration to change a schema object type (index → constraint), always add a companion forward migration that upgrades existing databases. Never rely on a modified old migration to fix databases that already ran the original version.
